title: Rivian's make-or-break R2 midsize EV delivers: Road test
title_zh: Rivian 的成败 R2 中型电动车交付：道路测试
summary: The Rivian R2 is, frankly, the most important vehicle Rivian has ever built. It's the car that's supposed to push Rivian over the edge on cost, scale, and profits.
summary_zh: 坦率地说，Rivian R2 是 Rivian 有史以来制造的最重要的车辆。这款汽车有望将 Rivian 推向成本、规模和利润的边缘。

title: Apple says Mac users in China can connect to Alibaba's Qwen AI service
title_zh: 苹果表示中国的 Mac 用户可以连接阿里巴巴的 Qwen AI 服务
summary: Apple has published a guide explaining how eligible Mac users in mainland China can connect Alibaba's Qwen artificial-intelligence service to ‌the U.S. tech giant's Siri digital assistant and Writing Tools feature.
summary_zh: 苹果发布了一份指南，解释了中国大陆符合条件的 Mac 用户如何将阿里巴巴的 Qwen 人工智能服务连接到美国科技巨头的 Siri 数字助理和书写工具功能。

title: AI theme has 'a long way to run': Strategist
title_zh: 战略家：人工智能主题“还有很长的路要走”
summary: Yahoo Finance host Jared Blikre and The Wealth Consulting Group Chief Market Strategist Talley Léger discuss market leadership shifting from tech concentration to diffusion, explaining why investors must take a 'leap of faith' on massive AI capital spending by tech hyperscaler...
summary_zh: 雅虎财经主持人 Jared Blikre 和财富咨询集团首席市场策略师 Talley Léger 讨论了市场领导力从技术集中转向扩散的问题，并解释了为什么投资者必须对科技超大规模企业的大规模人工智能资本支出抱有“信心的飞跃”……
